question: If the last twelve letters of the English alphabet series is reversed, which of the following will be the tenth to the left of the sixth letter from the right end?
solution:
As per the question,

 
• **If the last twelve letters of the English alphabet series is reversed, then the**** **new arrangement will be:

A B C D E F G H I J K L M N Z Y X W V U T S R Q P O

 
• **The sixth letter from the right end: **

(left) A B C D E F G H I J K L M N Z Y X W V U
